Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Nandini Pawar. I am a 30-year-old truck driver living in Kozhikode. Emerald Traders gave me a cheque for Rs 37,00,000 to repay a loan, but the cheque came back with the remark account closed. My case number is S.C.C. No. 2625/2024 in the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Kozhikode. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 71888 74107 or email nandini.pawar47@example.com.

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Kozhikode
age (30) + occupation (truck driver) + city (Kozhikode) + issue (cheque bounce)
